instruction: Collect at least 5 grams of granules from the tub into the sample jar using the sleeve-and-notched-rod sampler. Return the closed sampler upright to its holder and release both hands.

importance.basis: Laboratory granular subsampling by a closing notched rod; nearest board tasks and our own accepted/pending tasks compared.

construct_validity.basis: Actual contacts, passive return spring, integral pocket floor, native enclosed transport and gravity discharge. No runtime object/grain state writes.

scoring.basis: Mass, real notch provenance, closed and released support; human balance/ruler/video equivalents and 18 counterexample tests.

clarity_and_reproducibility.basis: Fixed dimensions/materials/layout/reset, clean reusable spheres, affordable printable construction and manufacturer procedure reference.

feasibility.basis: Final native score1.0 in2339/2800actions; ordinary grippers/drives; two-step registered interface and three cameras pass.
